theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.72%) and Consumer Staples (+0.26%) led the market today, while Technology (-3.19%) and Industrials (-2.99%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -1.47%, defensives -0.70%, and value/cyclicals -1.01% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -1.52%, Dow -2.19%, Nasdaq -1.74% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -1.61%. The VIX rose 13.52% to 20.66, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 2.90% to $4,138.30, crude oil was little changed at $84.27, and bitcoin gained 0.18% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
